description: This file implements Unix domain socket server management functions, including connection checks, creation, and cleanup of server sockets for a Unix stream server.

methods.name: int is_another_server_alive(const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts)
methods.description: Checks if another server is listening at the specified Unix socket path by attempting to connect and immediately disconnecting if successful.

methods.name: int unix_ss_create(const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts,long timeout_ms,struct unix_ss_socket ** new_server_socket)
methods.description: Creates and binds a Unix stream server socket at a specified path, employing file locking and ensuring no other server is running.

methods.name: void unix_ss_free(struct unix_ss_socket * server_socket)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the server socket, closing the socket and removing the socket file if it hasn't been stolen.

methods.name: int unix_ss_was_stolen(struct unix_ss_socket * server_socket)
methods.description: Determines if the server socket was stolen by checking if the socket file has been replaced or modified.

ctags.name: unix_ss_create
ctags.signature: (const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts,long timeout_ms,struct unix_ss_socket ** new_server_socket)
